notes: Draft only. Neither the currency caps nor the call counts are authorized.

Per-model-request USD 1.10 is a proposed conservative reservation for the full published text input context plus 32768 output tokens at the current standard price; actual route, billing class, token-limit semantics and price validity must be verified before enabling execution.

USD 5 at that reservation admits at most four model HTTP attempts, fewer than the twelve planned courses even if every course used only one attempt. Do not describe this draft as sufficient for all samples.
Speech reserve is a proposed conservative CNY 0.001 per UTF-8 byte, not a verified account tariff. It is tracked separately; this is not a new combined USD 5 proposal.
The existing normal service must route the installed skill through the gateway before route_verified can be true. Do not edit personal configuration or run a paid route probe as part of preparation.
Absolute build locations are private local prerequisites; reverify exact hashes/source and all runtime inputs before a future approval.
